entry.note: Kashaev, The hyperbolic volume of knots from the quantum dilogarithm, Lett. Math. Phys. 39 (1997). 10 bare-URL Refs → title+publisher.

relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN, with a correct key available. The seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994 (two authors, Mod. Phys. Lett. A 1994, arXiv:hep-th/9310070). This document is arXiv:q-alg/9601025v2, 'The hyperbolic volume of knots from quantum dilogarithm', by R. M. Kashaev ALONE, dated January 1996 (preprint ENSLAPP-L-577/96). The correct registered key already exists: kashaev1997 at folio/schema/references.ts:4323, 'The hyperbolic volume of knots from the quantum dilogarithm', Kashaev, Lett. Math. Phys. 39 (1997) 269-275, DOI 10.1023/A:1007364912784 - this preprint is that paper. Fourth of four uploads in this slice wrongly seeded to faddeev_kashaev1994. I have set id to kashaev1997. On relevance: this is the paper that states the volume conjecture (the invariant associated with the cyclic quantum dilogarithm grows exponentially at large N with the hyperbolic volume of the complement as growth rate), which is foundational for the framework's volume-based mass formula. Separately, a dangling-locator finding on the key it was misjoined to: five Lean sites cite '[faddeev_kashaev1994] https://doi.org/10.1142/S0217732394002446' (tm_dilogarithm_evaluation.lean:71,84 and the pentagon/monodromy/cyclic-dilog modules), but the registered faddeev_kashaev1994 entry carries DOI 10.1142/S0217732394000447 - a different DOI. Corpus-grep run for the volume conjecture before proposing: it is already present in the corpus via murakami-murakami 2001 and vanderveen2008, so no gap is being declared here.

keyResults.statement: For a hyperbolic knot or link, the absolute value of the cyclic-quantum-dilogarithm link invariant grows exponentially in N with the hyperbolic volume of the complement as the growth rate.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the volume-conjecture statement underlying the Vol(K) factor in the mass formula; the row should point at kashaev1997, which already has citation sites in the corpus, not at faddeev_kashaev1994.

proposedActions.rationale: Correct the join to kashaev1997 in the ledger so the volume-conjecture key finally has its source document attached, and so faddeev_kashaev1994 stops appearing verified by four documents none of which is it.

Five Lean sites cite faddeev_kashaev1994 with DOI 10.1142/S0217732394002446 while the registry entry has 10.1142/S0217732394000447. Reconcile - either the registry DOI or the Lean docstrings are wrong, and both cannot be the 1994 'Quantum dilogarithm'.
